requirements.description: Users log in with email and password
Password must be 8–20 chars with at least one uppercase letter, one digit and one special character
After 5 consecutive failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes
Employees can apply for Annual, Sick or Unpaid leave
Start date cannot be in the past; end date must be on or after start date
A single request can be 1 to 30 days
Reason field is optional, max 250 characters
Annual leave cannot exceed remaining balance (default 20 days/year)
Managers can approve or reject pending requests of their direct reports only
Employee receives an email notification on approval/rejection
Apply for leave: Employee, Manager, HR Admin = Yes
Approve/reject team leave: Employee = No, Manager = Yes, HR Admin = Yes
Edit leave balances: HR Admin only
View all employees' leave: Employee = No, Manager = Team only, HR Admin = Yes
POST /api/v1/leaves creates leave request (JWT required), returns 201 with leaveId
GET /api/v1/leaves/{id} fetches a leave request; 404 if not found
PATCH /api/v1/leaves/{id}/status with status APPROVED|REJECTED and comment; Managers/HR only

assumptions: Password policy (FR-1.2) is enforced wherever a password is set or changed; login screen does not reveal policy details on failure.
Login error is generic for wrong password and unknown email (no user enumeration).
Email address is case-insensitive and trimmed.
'Today' is a valid start date (not in the past).
Duration is inclusive of start and end date (start = end → 1 day).
Sick and Unpaid leave have no balance cap (none stated).
Approving a request does not require a comment; rejection comment is trimmed before the 10-char check.
HR Admin can approve/reject requests of all employees, not just a team.
A manager cannot approve their own request; it routes to their own manager.
API enum values are ANNUAL, SICK, UNPAID; field names type/startDate/endDate/reason are placeholders until the API contract is shared.
Validation errors on the API return 400 (could be 422) – to be confirmed.
openQuestions: Is leave duration counted in calendar days or working days (weekends/public holidays excluded)? Affects 1–30 limit and balance deduction.
Is Annual balance deducted on submission (reserved) or on approval? Do pending requests count toward the balance check?
Which timezone defines 'past' for start date – user, server or company locale?
Do failed attempts during a lock extend the 15-minute lock? Is there an admin unlock / password-reset path?
Are half-day leaves supported? Are balances decimal?
Is the default 20 days prorated for mid-year joiners, and is unused balance carried over at year end? How are requests spanning two years handled?
Are overlapping leave requests for the same employee allowed?
Can employees cancel/withdraw pending or approved requests (not specified)?
What is the exact wording of error messages and email templates? Is the manager notified on submission?
What is the HR Admin's scope for approval and who approves requests from managers/HR Admins themselves?
What is the balance-edit API/endpoint, and should GET /leaves/{id} return 403 or 404 for unauthorized access?
Is there an email retry policy if the mail service is down?
Are spaces and unicode allowed in passwords? Which characters count as 'special'?
